title: They are great and for a good price too!
text: They are great and for a good price too!. These are great! Although a lot bigger than I expected but they work great and much better quality than others I have bought online before similar to these. They also have antislip at the bottom and are flexible but a bit thicker than other similar ones. I like how they have the design for what to cut on each on them that makes it very useful as well.

product_metadata.title: Extra Thick Pastel Flexible Plastic Cutting Board Mats with Food Icons & EZ-Grip Waffle Back, (Set of 4) Dishwasher Safe
